page.layout: One printed plate, full page: an engraved Roman tomb relief. Above, a pedimented niche with a central bust and two side busts, each with a label. Below the relief, a framed inscription of five lines, then a lower panel with a blank cartouche and decorative rock work. No running head, page number or signature.
page.notes: Engraving: a Roman funerary relief in a pedimented frame. The central figure is a bust of a man in a laurel wreath and military dress with roundels (medallions) on the chest. Two side busts stand in the niche, each on a plinth bearing an inscription. The left label reads M·CAELIUS / ML / PRIVATUS, the right label M·CAELIUS / ML / THIAMINUS. The main inscription is engraved in the framed panel and partly cut off at the left edge; the first word of line 1 and the start of line 2 and line 4 are damaged, so their readings are doubtful and marked [?]. The line 2 "DLEG" may be "LEG" with a damaged letter before it. The lower panel is blank apart from rock and foliage decoration. Spelling is kept as printed in the labels and the inscription; the u/v rule is applied to the side labels only where they are plain Latin words.
